title: Space Coast Woodturners
description:
Topic: Space Coast Woodturners  
Time: Feb 14, 2024 7:00 PM Eastern Time (US and Canada)  
Every month on the Second Wednesday of each month.

Monthly meeting of the Space Coast Woodturners club. Open to the public. Masks are optional. Please come join us for an evening of woodturning topics, displays, demonstrations, social time, and usually a raffle!

Attend in person at the Melbourne Makerspace location or via our Zoom meeting.
